0.0: Ah, you're back. The Tigun Transformation Potion is now complete. Drink the potion and go to #b#p2101013##k to receive an order of silk. The merchant that deals with the queen should be around #b#m260010600##k.

yes.0: Once you have transformed into #p2101004#, you can't attack anyone. If you accidentally use a skill when using the disguise, everything will be ruined. Also, if you're attacked, the transformation will end. To summarize, do not engage in a fight on your way to #p2101013#.
yes.1: You will be transformed for #b1 hour#k. During that time, you should #bnever attack or be attacked#k. In that time, you must also get an order of silk from #p2101013# and safely come back. Good luck.

no.0: Did the potion scare you off? Hmmm, then who should I ask to do this? #p2101003#, since he looks a lot like Tigun?

1.0: Ohhhh, you're back. Did you get the order of silk from #p2101013#?

yes.0: Brilliant. Instead of fighting our fellow residents to steal the queen's treasures, it's much better to steal like this, nice and quiet, with no one realizing exactly what happened.

item.0: Hmmm... Haven't obtained the #b#t4031571##k yet? With the money we'll earn from that, the residents of #m260000000# won't go hungry for a while.

lost.0: Hmmm? You lost the #p2101013#-transformation potion? You didn't throw that away because it looked gross, did you? Don't worry. I made lots of potions using #p2101013#'s beard, so I'll give you another one.
